Presenting the first video song for Kaun Hoyega from the upcoming Punjabi film 'Qismat'
Qismat is an upcoming Punjabi movie produced by Shri Narotam Ji Production, scheduled to be released on 21st Sep, 2018. It is a romantic comedy directed by Jagdeep Sidhu and will feature Ammy Virk and Sargun Mehta as lead characters.

Singer: B Praak & Divya Bhatt
